visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair and bangs is seated on a dark grey sofa, focused on a white smartphone held horizontally. She wears a white button-up cardigan and red lipstick. The background is a plain white wall with a power socket. A colorful logo featuring a heart and the text '閃耀之星' is visible in the top right corner. (2) The scene cuts to a professional studio with a light grey background illuminated by vertical red and blue neon tubes. The woman stands in the center, wearing a white lace off-the-shoulder crop top and a matching ruffled mini-skirt with white boots. She smiles and performs subtle arm movements while looking directly at the camera. (3) The woman is shown in a different outfit consisting of a grey cropped hoodie over a grey sports bra and grey cargo trousers. She poses with her hands on her hips, then makes various gestures like finger hearts and framing her face. The studio background and neon lighting remain consistent. (4) She changes into a grey sleeveless crop top and a black pleated skirt, with large white bows tied in her hair. She turns her back to the camera, then looks over her shoulder to wave with a cheerful expression. (5) Now wearing a white strapless dress decorated with small black butterfly bows and her hair in pigtails, she waves and makes finger hearts. A game interface with colorful arrows and a progress bar appears at the bottom of the frame. (6) A 2D anime girl with pink hair and a red jacket appears on the left side of the screen, dancing in synchronization with the woman. Stars and text overlays like 'GOOD', 'GREAT', and 'PERFECT' flash on the screen above their heads. (7) The woman in the white butterfly dress addresses the camera directly, gesturing invitingly with her hands. The screen is eventually covered by a large logo and app store buttons for iOS and Google Play with accompanying text labels.
